post.originalText:
I gave Claude and ChatGPT the same job: build a cinematic 3D tsunami hitting a Mediterranean town. One HTML file, pure Three.js, no assets.

Top: Claude Opus 5.5, $10.53
 Bottom: ChatGPT, $13.25

What each one delivered:
Claude
 → the sea pulls back and boats get stranded on the exposed seabed
 → the wave knocks the lighthouse over and the lamp goes out
 → houses come apart and the debris floats on the real water surface
 → slow-motion impact, then a flooded aftermath
 → export buttons for 16:9, 4:5 and 9:16, plus a key to hide the UI for recording
ChatGPT
 → ran on the first try, with no broken imports this time
 → the wave and the flood both work
 → a heavy pink haze and huge hills 
cover half the frame
 → skipped the aspect-ratio buttons and the hide-UI key the prompt asked for

Claude came out $2.72 cheaper and gave the more cinematic result.
